# Supports and tanks over a row of random battles (generated by dtcli support-chains)

Balance variant. 8 random battles of the floor of each checkpoint in a row, HP and TP carried over, 40 rows a cell, the same rows for every role. Each role in the last place of the reference party. Cells: rows walked to the end / HP the party has left / TP it has left. The last columns: the mean over the checkpoints of the HP and the TP left, as points above the party with an attacker in that place (the control).
